description: Two-host edge-HTTP witness. The attacker brute-forces HTTP Basic Auth on a web target and exfiltrates a protected secret over the authenticated channel. The web server is a free element: the canonical SUT runs Apache, a generated variant substitutes Nginx, and both serve the same Basic Auth attack chain to completion under one unchanged corpus fingerprint.

techniques.name: Network Service Discovery
techniques.description: From the attacker host, probe the web target for an HTTP service answering on :80.

techniques.name: Brute Force: Password Guessing
techniques.description: Lab pre-stages a weak HTTP Basic Auth credential; the attacker iterates a tiny wordlist until one entry returns HTTP 200.

techniques.name: Valid Accounts
techniques.description: Authenticate to the protected resource with the recovered credentials.

techniques.name: Data from Local System
techniques.description: Read the protected secret over the authenticated HTTP channel.
